title: 第922章 动什么动第921章 甘承其重
lines: 【出类拔萃，道德值+2000】
看着迟到的提示，吴谦顿时松了口气。
这才是一个返虚境应有的数值回馈。
虽然比赵真如那次4000还略逊一筹，但两次加起来3000，也算是不少了。
此时别说拿下赵真襄，就算把赵真襄赵真如沐洋都叫到一起。
吴谦也有信心一锅烩了！
烩完之后，还能跟上万个阴傀掰持掰持！
没办法，这就是充能的好处。
换句话说，若是连这些都应付不了，系统还算是系统么？
一切正如赵真襄所言，她仅凭一臂之力，便将吴谦牢牢的控制在身下。
哪怕吴谦不运功腾空，也能稳躺云端，丝毫不用担心会掉下去。
与此同时，赵真襄也爆发出前所未有的激进。
将吴谦怼的七荤八素，比吴谦怼她时还要暴力，还要凶残。
让吴谦明白了，传说中的观音吸土，并非只是传说。
耳边传来灵力撞击的声响，既沉闷又震耳欲聋。
吴谦还是头一回在这种时刻，听到如此炸裂的声响。
不由感叹返虚境果然不同凡响。
同时被撞的眼冒金星，一时分不清东西南北……
白云虽能阻隔空中的画面，却挡不住声音的传播。
或者说由于空旷无阻，声音比在平地上，传播还要顺畅！
听着半空雷鸣般的掌声，仿佛天兵天将在鼓掌。
刘玉显然被勾起心事，脸色阴郁无比。
他无法想象，自己的贵妃和吴谦在一起时，是不是也发生过同样的画面。
刘玉是不近女色，但并不代表他不是男人，更不是对男人的尊严真的毫不在意。
声音在皇城回荡，全城所有人都听到这无耻的声音。
只让女人汗毛倒竖，男子倒竖……
身为皇上，皇城的最高领袖，这份尴尬终是落到刘玉一人头上。
怕别人也联想到贵妃，刘玉抑制住震怒，自言自语的揣着明白装糊涂。
“这是什么动静？”
他本要自问自答，说是不是打雷该收衣服了。
但听到问题，一旁的吴厚多机灵啊，立即凑上前答道，
content_en:
[Outstanding, moral value +2000]
Seeing the reminder of being late, Wu Qian breathed a sigh of relief.
This is the numerical feedback that a Void Return Realm should have.
Although it is slightly lower than the 4,000 paid by Zhao Zhenru that time, the total of 3,000 paid twice is still a lot.
Let alone capture Zhao Zhenxiang at this time, even if Zhao Zhenxiang and Zhao Zhenru Mu Yang are called together.
Wu Qian is also confident that he can cook it all in one pot!
After cooking, you can still keep up with thousands of Yin puppets!
No way, this is the benefit of charging.
In other words, if it cannot cope with these, is the system still a system?
Everything was just as Zhao Zhenxiang said, she had Wu Qian firmly under her control with just one arm.
Even if Wu Qian doesn't use his skills to fly into the air, he can still lie firmly on the clouds without worrying about falling.
At the same time, Zhao Zhenxiang also burst out with unprecedented radicalism.
The way Wu Qian fought against her was even more violent and cruel than when Wu Qian fought against her.
Wu Qian understood that the legendary Guanyin sucking earth was not just a legend.
The sound of spiritual energy hitting his ears was dull and deafening.
This was the first time Wu Qian heard such an explosion at such a moment.
I couldn’t help but sigh that the Return to Void Realm was indeed extraordinary.
At the same time, I was hit so hard that I couldn't tell the difference between east, west, north and south...
…
Although the white clouds can block the images in the sky, they cannot stop the transmission of sound.
In other words, because of the open space, the sound propagates more smoothly than on flat ground!
Listening to the thunderous applause in the air, it felt like heavenly soldiers and generals were applauding.
Liu Yu was obviously aroused, and his face was extremely gloomy.
He couldn't imagine that the same scene happened when his concubine and Wu Qian were together.
Liu Yu is not close to women, but it does not mean that he is not a man, nor does he really care about the dignity of men.
The sound echoed in the imperial city, and everyone in the city heard this shameless sound.
It only makes women’s hair stand on end and men’s hair stand on end…
As the emperor and the supreme leader of the imperial city, this embarrassment finally fell on Liu Yu alone.
Afraid that others would also think of the imperial concubine, Liu Yu suppressed her anger and muttered to herself, pretending to be confused.
"What's this noise?"
He wanted to ask himself whether it was time to put away his clothes due to thunder.
But when he heard the question, Wu Houduo, who was on the side, was so clever that he immediately stepped forward and answered,
